items.title: Hero Motors shares make lackluster debut, list at 2% discount to IPO price
items.description: The initial public offering of Hero Motors received bids for 58.97 crore shares as against 8.86 crore shares on offer. The issue was subscribed 6.66 times.

items.title: Stock Market LIVE: Sensex gains 100 pts, Nifty tops 23,300; Arvind SmartSpaces shares jump 12%
items.description: Sensex Today | Stock Market LIVE Updates Wednesday: In the broader markets, the Nifty MidCap and the Nifty SmallCap rose 0.29 per cent and 0.52 per cent, respectively

items.title: SS Retail shares make strong D-street debut, list 51% above IPO price
items.description: The offer received bids for 90.83 crore shares as against 87.93 lakh shares on offer. The issue was subscribed 103.30 times.

items.title: Jindal Supreme shares off to a solid start, list at 31% premium on BSE
items.description: Jindal Supreme's IPO was a mix of a fresh issue of ₹100 crore and an offer for sale of ₹25 crore, with a total offer size of ₹125 crore. The IPO price band was set at ₹88-93 per share.

items.title: 'Equity investment across market-caps warrants a staggered approach'
items.description: With clear signs of an FY27 earnings revival, a stable INR and an anticipated dovish Fed, make case for an attractive FII entry point, said Anuj Kapoor of JM Financial.

items.title: Data centre bet makes ESDS one of India's best-performing new listings
items.description: ESDS Software Solution Ltd. has surged over 300% since its trading debut on Sept. 4, putting it on course to rank among India's best-performing new listings

items.title: Nasdaq hits record high as oil prices fall on improved West Asia flows
items.description: The Nasdaq was boosted by Micron Technology and other ​AI-related stocks as AI demand showed no signs of abating and corporate earnings stayed resilient

items.title: Asian shares eye sixth straight session of gains as AI stocks rally
items.description: Renewed buzz over AI helped South Korean stocks gain 1.2%, with Samsung and SK Hynix both up over 2%

items.description: Five Adani Group companies have settled SEBI adjudication proceedings linked to the Hindenburg report.

items.title: Chandan Taparia bets on Sona BLW, Bandhan Bk; sees Nifty support at 23,200
